file_stem: RWB E1 058 Agent platform set up E1a
title: Agent platform set-up [E1a]
goal: One governed path for every agent: model gateway, versioned prompts and policies, guardrails
why: No agent talks to a model directly. Inputs are masked, outputs are checked, every run is recorded with cost, and Risk approves each prompt and policy.
ace_note: No ACE read in the platform itself. Agents read data only through allowed tools (ToolGateway) that call published module interfaces.

writes.note: autonomy mode, timeout, confidence floor, cost
one row per run: status, tokens, cost, latency

stores: INT-23 model endpoint (private endpoint, DL33 option B via AAL); P4 masking service; outbox EV-28 AgentRunCompleted

path.text: Answer, or fallback to the rule result

rules: BR3: timeout 60 s -> TIMED_OUT, the rule result is used
BR4: checks run in order schema -> tools -> confidence floor
BR7: cost = (tokens in + out) / 1000 x price_per_1k_tokens_thb
BR8: the loader of a prompt or policy cannot approve it
risks: Model timeout -> TIMED_OUT, fallback (no user message)
example: Agent ECHO, policy P1 / prompt PR1, model MODEL-A-2026-10, case RW-2026-000101
-> ANSWERED in 1,200 ms, 900 tokens in, 150 out
